summary: Full e2e testing of iteration 2 (shareable /r/:sessionId + per-row Gemini Draft a reply). All 13 backend pytest tests pass (10 prior + 3 new for /api/draft). Frontend full flow verified: hero -> scanning (4 stages) -> results stays at '/' -> Share copies /r/<id> URL with 'Copied' state -> expand cold row -> Draft a reply shows 'Drafting...' then real Gemini draft (390 chars) in soft pink card -> Copy draft copies to clipboard. Share page /r/<valid> shows banner with cold_count interpolated ('They have 8 conversations going cold'), document.title updates to '8 cold conversations — Shram', no draft buttons or rescan visible (readOnly enforced). /r/<invalid> shows share-not-found with start-own button. Real Gemini path verified for both scan and draft.
action_items: Two static-resource 404s observed in browser console (likely favicon or font preload). Non-blocking but worth checking /app/frontend/public for missing referenced asset to keep console clean.
critical_code_review_comments: POST /api/draft/{session_id}/{thread_id} correctly looks up session then thread inside cold_threads and 404s appropriately. Good.
Draft endpoint has a sane fallback to a templated reply if Gemini call fails, similar pattern to /scan. Good for demo resilience.
SharePage correctly threads readOnly=true into <Results>; ColdRow gates the entire Draft a reply block on !readOnly. Good.
Document.title side-effect in SharePage useEffect is fine but never resets when navigating away from /r/<id>; minor (not user-visible since SPA tab stays on Shram).
MainFlow does not navigate to /r/<id> after scan (owner stays at '/'), matching spec. Good.
Clipboard API used without Permissions-Policy guard — works in modern browsers; fallback toast.error('Could not copy') exists. Acceptable.

All new interactive elements have data-testid (draft-reply-button-<id>, draft-reply-output-<id>, copy-draft-button-<id>, copy-share-link, share-banner, share-run-own, share-not-found, share-start-own-button). Excellent testability.
test_credentials: N/A — no auth (Gmail OAuth intentionally simulated per spec).
seed_data_creation: TEST_-prefixed access requests created via existing tests; one real scan session created (8 cold of 14) and used for share page + draft testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: 13 pytest tests at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py all pass. /api/draft/{session_id}/{thread_id} returns ~3-4s latency real Gemini drafts; falls back gracefully on error. Frontend BrowserRouter routes '/' (MainFlow) and '/r/:sessionId' (SharePageWrapper) both work. Draft button renders in expanded ColdRow only when !readOnly; share page enforces readOnly so neither Draft a reply nor Rescan appears there. Document.title updates on share page. Two 404 static-resource console errors were the only console issues observed.
rca of the issue: N/A — no defects found. Iteration 2 features (share URL + draft reply) ship-ready.
